About these 3 rides

They ride on Wednesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays. The earliest start is KVBC Fairlawn Starter at 9:00 am; the latest is KVBC Wednesday Slow Roll at 6:10 pm. After work, 2 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 2 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 2. By bike: 2 road and 1 social. Each one was checked at its source between Oct 1 and Oct 26, 2026.
